cards.front: State the formula for the sum of interior angles in a polygon with $n$ sides.

options.explanation: A polygon can be divided into $n - 2$ triangles from one vertex. Each triangle has angle sum $180^\circ$, so multiplying gives the total interior angle sum.
This counts one triangle too many when dividing the polygon from a single vertex. The correct relationship uses $n - 2$ triangles, each contributing $180^\circ$.
Multiplying the number of sides directly by $180^\circ$ ignores the two fewer triangles formed inside the polygon. The correct formula is based on $n - 2$ triangles.
The triangle angle sum has been incorrectly replaced by a full turn. Each of the $n - 2$ triangles contributes $180^\circ$, not $360^\circ$.
